title: Ensuring Reliability of Curated EHR-Derived Data: The Validation of Accuracy for LLM/ML-Extracted Information and Data (VALID) Framework
reasoning: The paper presents a technical framework for evaluating the accuracy and reliability of clinical data extracted by LLMs from electronic health records. Although it discusses 'fairness' and 'bias' in the context of demographic subgroup performance, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical systems.
